name: cog-second-brain
description: Codex-first second brain built on Markdown, with skills for onboarding, capture, briefing, reflection, and synthesis.

skills.name: onboarding
skills.description: Stand up a Codex-native COG vault and seed profile, interests, and projects.

skills.name: braindump
skills.description: Capture raw thoughts, classify domain, and file structured notes with actions.

skills.name: daily-brief
skills.description: Generate a 7-day-fresh intelligence brief tied to the user's interests and watchlist.

skills.name: weekly-checkin
skills.description: Run a weekly reflection across braindumps and briefs to spot patterns and plan next week.

skills.name: knowledge-consolidation
skills.description: Distill scattered notes into frameworks and cross-links.
